snippet.title: Helldivers 2 - Heart of Democracy | PS5 & PC Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/helldivers-2/

Helldivers, the Illuminate have reached the Heart of Democracy. Our Mega Cities are under siege. Liberty now hangs in the balance. The Ministry of Defense has authorized arsenal upgrades and placed SEAF soldiers on active duty. Today, we fight for the future of Super Earth! 

#ps5 #ps5games #pcgames #helldivers2 

Rated Mature
